instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: Fusion Summon 1 Shaddoll Fusion using hand/field materials. Once/turn. Fusion Summon 1 Shaddoll Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. You can only activate 1 El Shaddoll Fusion per turn.

End Phase: Venom Counters; -500 ATK each. During each player's End Phase: Place 1 Venom Counter on each face-up monster, except Venom monsters. Monsters lose 500 ATK for each Venom Counter on them. Destroy a monster if its ATK becomes 0 by this effect.
